findings.current: And there was only one person who had gone beyond a simple acquaintance and openly said he genuinely respected Siegfried.
findings.defect: The subject and object of the respect are reversed. Siegfried said that he respected one person; the draft says that one person said he respected Siegfried.
findings.rationale: The following identification of that person as Cheon Taemin confirms that Siegfried is the one expressing respect.
findings.replacement: And beyond those mere connections, there was only one person Siegfried openly said he genuinely respected.
findings.source: 그와 인연을 맺은 사람은 나를 포함해서 아주 극소수였고, 단순한 인연을 넘어 진심으로 존경한다고 밝힌 사람은 한 명밖에 없었지.

findings.current: At least, he had been until the day he was discovered as a corpse in his hideout.
findings.defect: The draft omits the explicit fact that he was found today and renders the sentence in awkward, indirect English.
findings.rationale: 오늘 explicitly anchors the discovery to the present day.
findings.replacement: At least until today, when he was found dead in his own hideout.
findings.source: 적어도 오늘, 자신의 은신처에서 시신으로 발견되기 전까지는.

findings.current: Just as sewage did not become perfectly clear even after being purified, Magic Gems and monster corpses were the same.
findings.defect: Rendering 똥물 as the neutral “sewage” sanitizes the deliberately crude image and weakens Taekyung’s comic, vulgar narrative voice.
findings.rationale: 똥물 is bluntly and comically vulgar, literally “shit water,” rather than the comparatively clinical “sewage.”
findings.replacement: Just as filtering shit water wouldn’t make it perfectly clear, the same was true of Magic Gems and monster corpses.
findings.source: 똥물을 정수해도 완벽하게 맑아지지 않듯이, 마정석이나 몬스터의 사체 역시 마찬가지다.

findings.current: I sent him messages every Thanksgiving and Christmas, but after three years ago, I never received another reply.
findings.defect: “After three years ago” is ungrammatical, and “messages” unnecessarily narrows the source’s general 연락.
findings.rationale: 삼 년 전을 기점으로 means that the lack of replies began three years ago and continued afterward.
findings.replacement: I reached out every Thanksgiving and Christmas, but starting three years ago, he stopped replying.
findings.source: 추수감사절이나 크리스마스 때마다 연락을 보냈지만, 삼 년 전을 기점으로 돌아오는 대답은 없었어.

findings.current:
> **A new Quest has been generated!**
>
> **An Unexpected Quest, Unknown Death, is being forcibly accepted!**
findings.defect: The complete System notices are wrapped in bold, contrary to the required System-panel Markdown convention.
findings.rationale: The blockquote and System heading already identify the UI panel; bold is reserved for meaningful labels or emphasis rather than entire notices.
findings.replacement:
> A new Quest has been generated!
>
> An Unexpected Quest, Unknown Death, is being forcibly accepted!
findings.source:
― 새로운 퀘스트가 생성되었습니다!

― 돌발 퀘스트, [알 수 없는 죽음]이 강제 수락됩니다!

summary: One critical relationship reversal, one omitted temporal fact, one meaningful register loss, and two localized presentation or wording issues.
